text: The Latollo Puffots (Japanese: , Ratorō Shigaru) are four Bosses in . They are members of the Puffot family and are fought at level 22 after chasing Rhys to Umon's Shipyard in the Gormott Province. This enemy drops no items.

Killi-Killi Killifishes are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Leftherian Archipelago, in particular from Collection Points on the northwest and southeast sides of Baldotas Isle or near Godsford Isle. Three are needed to unlock Corvin's level 2 Forestry skill.
King Marigolds are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in the Cliffs of Morytha. In the , King Marigolds can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Lacquer Stones are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, specifically at the Collection Point at the entrance to the Sacred Ice Caverns.
Keydal Accessories is a shop in . It is located in Torigoth of the Gormott Province, where it is run by Rheena. It is specialized in Accessories.
Kinkir Accessories is a shop in . It is run by Bidibi and can be found in the Cliffs of Morytha's Inlet. It is specialized in Accessories.

The Land of the Beaten (Japanese: , Yabureshi-mono no Chi) is a Location in . It is located in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya, beneath the Old Pilgrim's Road. It can be easily reached by going down the stairs and jumping off into the first pool of water passed over.

Krezzi Temtem is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found in the lower area to the east of the Theosoir Main Gate in the Kingdom of Tantal, on the lower level of the cafe sitting at a table with two Tantalese women. He will offer to trade the Tome of Morytha #1 for items with a total Excitement Quota of at least 100 during Adenine's Books. The Cute Fluffy Ears set must be traded, made up of Gormotti-Ear Headband, Fluffy Snow Bug, and Fire Tarantula. Any other items traded are wasted. He only appears after entering the World Tree for the first time.
Laserpoint Bazooka (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using an Ether Cannon.

Land Volffs (Japanese: , Rando Vorufu) are enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 26-29 at the Old Industrial District in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Ten must be defeated during the quest Road to the Capital.
Kyamel Sovereigns (Japanese: , Kyameru Roiyaru) are enemies in . They are Sovereigns found at level 56 at the Roadway to 7th Perimeter on the World Tree during the quest World Tree Disaster.

Kyth Drivers (Japanese: , Kīsu Doraibā) are enemies in . They are Driver enemies. One can be found at level 28 on the northernmost path of the Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain, alongside a Cheren Driver and a Zalts Driver.

The King Laia (Japanese: , Kingu Raia) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Laia family, and can be found at level 60 at the Xataris Spring in Temperantia during the quest The Calm and the Storm.
Kiara is an NPC in . Kiara is a Gormotti who can be found at night at Abble's Fountain in the Gormott Province. Kiara gives the quest Bearing Her Soul.
Kirk is an NPC in . He is a Leftherian who can be found near Verde Carpentry Workshop or at the Azure Schoolhouse in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Koorell Pool (Japanese: , Kūreru Suimyaku) is a Location in . It is located on the upper right level of the Gormott Province. It can be reached by jumping down behind Immovable Gonzalez northeast of Nocclia Woods, or by following the underground path below the Verdant Plateau. There is one Collection Point here.
Lacie is an NPC in . She is an Urayan who can be found at the Entertainment District in the Kingdom of Uraya. She is involved during the Quest Eternal Spirit.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Knockback Resist (Japanese: , Nokkubakku Teikō) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It boosts the user's resistance to the Knockback reaction by up to 60%. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
The Keycode is a Key Item in . It is needed to access the Sky Bridge in the World Tree. It is obtained in the Data Processing Room on the Lower Level of the World Tree.

The Ladder Key is a Key Item in . It is obtained by opening the Treasure Trove at the entrance to the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It grants access to a terminal that lowers the inspection ladder outside the Old Factory Warehouse.

The Krug Driver (Japanese: , Kuruga Doraibā) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . He is a Driver, and can be found at level 62 at the Olethro Ruins in the Kingdom of Uraya during the quest Farewell, Good Friend.
Lansmeyer Accessories is a shop in . It is run by Talisandre and can be found at Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. It is specialized in Accessories for Drivers.
Lassa is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian soldier who can be found at the Ardainian Garrison in Temperantia. He must be spoken to during the quest A Secret Cure. Lassa gives no quests or Merc Missions.

The Kingdom Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Shipyard Security. It enables the purchase of Dealing Kingdoms from the Elgeschel Hobby Store shop at Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Killifish Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Merchant Ship. It enables the purchase of Smoke-Braised Killifish from the Coral Leaf Fresh Fish shop at Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Landmarks (Japanese: , randomāku) are a type of place in the . They are small points of interest found in each Area or Region that can be instantly traveled to via Skip Travel. Some special Landmarks are called Secret Areas.

This page lists all the Merc Missions available in the Kingdom of Uraya. The list may be viewed in the order they appear in the Merc Group Log. Terms and abbreviations are explained in the legend at the bottom of the page. |-| Mission Log = Mission Log |-| Requirements and Rewards = Requirements and Rewards * Base reward values for Gold and Experience are increased with higher Merc Levels.

This page lists all the Merc Missions available in the Kingdom of Tantal. The list may be viewed in the order they appear in the Merc Group Log. Terms and abbreviations are explained in the legend at the bottom of the page. |-| Mission Log = Mission Log |-| Requirements and Rewards = Requirements and Rewards * Base reward values for Gold and Experience are increased with higher Merc Levels.
Kikina is an NPC in . He is a Nopon found in the Plaza of Reprieve in the Kingdom of Uraya. He offers the Merc Mission Containing the Chaos.

Konakona (Jp: スミスミ Sumisumi) is an NPC in . Konakona is a Nopon who can be found on Drillbore Bridge in the Kingdom of Uraya. Konakona gives the DLC quest M.I.A. Nopon upon installing the New Quests Pack 1 of the Expansion Pass.
Kisasa is an NPC in . She is a Nopon who can be found at the Goldmouth Res. Dist. in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Larmogg Salvaging is a shop in . It can be found at the Ayvill Shopping District of Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It is run by Uthkine and specialized in Cylinders.
* Kountess Search Brief (Gormott) * Kountess Search Brief (Mor Ardain) * Kountess Search Brief (Tantal) * Kountess Search Brief (Uraya)

The Key to Something is a Key Item in . It can be obtained from a Treasure Trove at Yurna the Elderwood during the quest The Nopon Murals. At the end of the quest it will become the Ancient Nopon Key, which opens the Noponya Shrine.

Kupon is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. He was an old acquaintance of the Nopon Salvager and Driver Noporikh, as well as his Blade, Kasandra. Kupon particularly dislikes Kasandra due to the bad luck she brings to those around her.
Kitarmo Squoods (Japanese: , Getyūmu Suīdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Squood family, and can be found at level 44-48 on Godsford Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago after Salvaging.

Lapupu is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found at Elmos Square in the Kingdom of Tantal. He is one of the three NPCs who can be invited to teach at Azure Schoolhouse during the quest Language Teacher, however he will not join unless paid 7,500 G.
Koacurio Accessories is a shop in . It is run by Catli and can be found at the Refugee Campground in the Indoline Praetorium. It is specialized in Accessories for Drivers.
The Land of Challenge is a recurring location in the . * Land of Challenge (XC2), in . * Land of Challenge (XC3), in .

The Larm Igna (Japanese: , Noijī Igūna) is a quest-exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 59 in the Isle of Urchon of the Leftherian Archipelago during the DLC quest Bright Spark, alongside the Larm and Scram Ignas. This enemy drops no items.

Lapse Fliers (Japanese: , Rapusu Furaia) are enemies in . They are members of the Flier family and can be found at level 4 - 9 in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna, particularly near Porton Village and Hangnail Crossing.

Krogane is an NPC in . He is a Blade who is initially found at Lascham Cove in Gormott, and later at the Aletta: Militia Garrison. He gives the quests Blade Coaching and Further Blade Coaching. Krogane's Driver is the Nopon Rolipoli, and both of their Communities are gained after completion of Fusion Coaching.

Lake Wynn (Japanese: , Areguria-ko, Lake Alegria) is a location in . It is a lake beside the Loftin Nature Preserve, located in the southern area of the Dannagh Region in the Kingdom of Torna. A water geyser here requiring Level 2 Water Mastery leads up to the Verdant Fairylands.

Lasaria Woodland (Japanese: , Risaria Genseirin) is a landmark in . It is the first landmark in the game, and is located in the southernmost tip of the Lasaria Region, directly before Porton Village. Lora and Jin are chased here by the local wildlife, which have been driven into a frenzied state due to the smell of blood.

Lake Sarleigh (Japanese: , Seriosu-ko) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of the Aletta Region in the Kingdom of Torna, directly below Lett Bridge and adjacent to Wrackham Moor. A Geyser here may be activated using the Level 3 Water Mastery Field Skill to reach the Millennium Grotto after the lake has been flooded by the waterfall in Ossum Magnum.

Lascham Cove (Japanese: , Rasukamu no Minato) is a landmark in . It is located in the southwestern area of Gormott. An Ardainian battleship is moored at the dock. There are several Collection Points and green barrels containing Red Pollen Orbs here, and no enemies except during quests.
The Lakeshore Campsite (Japanese: , Kohan no Kyanpu) is a landmark in . It is a Campsite located by a small lake in the center of the southern edge of Gormott, near Lyanne Meadow.
Lactonuts are Vegetable collectible items in . They can be found at Wrackham Moor and Hyber Village in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna.
Krabble Carapaces are Enemy Part collectible items in . They are exclusively dropped by Krabble enemies.
The Knit Hat with Cute Trim is a Key Item in . It is obtained during Bolstering Sales after providing Obibi with 4 Corkscrew Creepers, 3 Panda Pansies, and a Floral Soil.

Knoober Pods (Japanese: , Nūberu Poddo) are minor enemies in . They are Antol Pods that can be found at level 33-40 at The Great Breaksand in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. They will hatch into Survee Antols.

Klaret Wisps (Japanese: , Ekurēru Ranpusu) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Wisp family and can be found at level 28 - 40 at the Verdant Fairylands in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna.
Korwyn is a NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found at Anangham #2 Dock in the Empire of Mor Ardain with his family.
Lapis Vangs (Japanese: , Rapisu Vanpu) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Vang family, and can be found at level 36-38 on Duelists' Bridge and Valafum Hill in Gormott.
This page lists all the quests available in the Kingdom of Torna. de:Liste aller Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Torna - The Golden Country

Komemi is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can initially be found in Acheron Backstreet in Auresco in the Kingdom of Torna, and later at the Aletta: Militia Garrison. He is one of the "Four Muskerpon", a group of Nopon brothers containing Rooroo, Kachakacha and Yokuyoku who all share one Community portrait (he is at the top). He is involved during the quests Forest Trail Antics and Making Up the Numbers, and his Community is gained upon completion of the latter alongside Luc and Vronka.
Lascham Weapons is a shop in . It is run by a peddler and can be found at Lascham Cove in Gormott. It is specialized in Core Chips.
Lascham Accessories is a shop in . It is run by a peddler and can be found at Lascham Cove in Gormott. It is specialized in Accessories.
Koto of Self-Intrest is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Addam at Campsites.
Kulakula is an NPC in . She is a Nopon courier who is found in the Fonsett Residential Area of the Leftherian Archipelago, where she is delivering letters. Kulakula offers no quests or Merc Missions.
Laennar is a High Entia in . He can be found at Companions' Cape on the Bionis' Shoulder. He gives the quest Laennar's Worries. Later, he can be found at Agni's Birthplace.

Kilopumpkins (Japanese: , Panpukiron) are collectables in . They can be found on the Bionis' Shoulder. According to their description, they are known for their sweetness, these squashes are a treasured dessert ingredient. Seven are needed for Sweetest Debt.
Laennar's Worries (Japanese: , Renāto no Nayami) is a quest in . It can be received from Laennar at the Companions' Cape on Bionis' Shoulder, or later at Agni's Birthplace near Gran Dell.

The Lamentation Ridge (Japanese: , Nageki no Tōge) is a location in . It is one of the tall land strips above the Bionis' Shoulder, running across the entire map from above Gamaro Hollow to above Cragmaw Caverns. It can only be reached from a spur north of Shoulderstone Scree, and the Secret Area Cloudtop Lookout sits at the southernmost tip. The Dawn Smiles can be found here during Sorrow, and the Ponspector Hekasa can be found on a descending spur to the south.

Laffaelle is a High Entia in . who is initially met near Thulles Way on the Bionis' Shoulder after the first story-required visit to Alcamoth. She is the subject of the surprise quest, No Armu Done, triggered by approaching her position. After her rescue, she relocates to Gran Dell.

Kino in the Doldrums (Japanese: , Yūutsuna Kino, Melancholic Kino) is a Quiet Moment in . It is located on Junks on the Bionis' Shoulder, between Melia and Kino, at night in clear weather and after visiting Gran Dell.
Knee-High Boots are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They are the initial starting equipment for Melia, and can only be worn by her.
Knee-High Boots D are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Melia.
Knee-High Boots L are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Melia.
Last Hope (Japanese: , Rasutohōpu) is Nia's Level I Blade Special in .
Lacerna Noctis (Japanese: , Yamiugatsukurokihagoromo) is Corvin's Level II Blade Special in . Using this special is the only way to dispel the Enraged status.
Lacerator (Japanese: , Midarezaki) is Obrona's Level IV Blade Special in .
Lady's Ribbons are heavy head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game. They can only be worn by Nene.
Lady's Plates are heavy torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game. They can only be worn by Nene.
Lady's Amulets are heavy arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game. They can only be worn by Nene.
Lady's Knapsacks are heavy legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game. They can only be worn by Nene.
Lady's Anklets are heavy feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game. They can only be worn by Nene.
Land Feris are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Feris family, and can be found at level 23-24 at Dumas' Jaw on the Rae-Bel Tableland.
Laprel Knoll (Japanese: , Riperu no Oka, Lipel Hill) is a Location in . It is located in Ribbi Flats.

Kilocorn Grandeps (Japanese: , Senkokaku no Gurandepusu, lit. Millenary Horned Grandeps) is a Superboss in . It is a Unique Monster and a member of the Ardun family and can be initially found at level 95 at Dumas' Jaw in Rae-Bel Tableland. The Monarch's Heart Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it. Through re-challenging, Kilocorn Grandeps' level can be increased to a maximum at level 150.
Ladras Way (Japanese: , Radorasu no Michi) is a location in , located on Captocorn Peak.
The Ladras Camp (Japanese: , Radorasu no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in , located near Ladras Way on Captocorn Peak.
Landslide (Japanese: , Randosuraido) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Stalker class.
Lake Rezzento is a location in , located in the Eagus Wilderness. The Lake Rezzento Camp Rest Spot is located here.

Lapdog Veece (Japanese: , Kiku no Vīsu, Starved Hound Veece) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Volff family, and can be found at level 9 at Volff Lair in Alfeto Valley. The Beast Howl Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class for defeating it.
Kilmarris Highland (Japanese: , Kimarisu no Takadai) is a Landmark in . It is located in Millick Meadows in the Aetia Region.
The Lake Rezzento Camp (Japanese: , Resento-ko no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located at Lake Rezzento in the Eagus Wilderness. The Wilderness Caravan is located here.
The Lambda Shelter (Japanese: , Koronī Ramuda: Yaeichi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located right outside Colony Lambda at the Great Cotte Falls.
Krezen Cliffs (Japanese: , Kuresen Kaigan) is a Location in . It is located in Erythia Sea, behind the Fourth Pillar Remnant.

The Lambda Canteen (Japanese: , Koronī Ramuda: Dōnai Shokudō) is a Rest Spot in . It is located in Colony Lambda at the Great Cotte Falls. The Redfish Grillwrap can be ordered here. This rest spot is unlocked by completing the quest Lambda's Problem.

King Krawkin (Japanese: , Chōketsu-ō Jākin) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 102 in the Demihuman Gutter in Erythia Sea. It forms the duo "The King-Kings" with Conqueror Deepwan. The Desperate Charge Art can be earned for the Soulhacker class upon defeating it.
Kismet Crossing (Japanese: , Shikkuzāru Kōsaro, lit. Schicksal Crossing) is a Location in . It is located at Fort O'Virbus on the Syra Hovering Reefs.
Killy Fors (Japanese: , Kirī no Taki) is a Landmark in , located in Ribbi Flats. It is found at the end of the stream flowing from Tonic Waters.
Klondos Table (Japanese: , Kondosu no Daichi) is a Location in . It is located in Dannagh Desert in the Fornis Region.
Krodlaxes are a family of aquatic enemies in and . They appear identical to the Gradies found in and .
Krammits are a family of crab-like enemies in and . They are similar to Krabbles and Paguls.
Korresia Finds Her Calling is a Standard Quest in . Juniper must be in the party during this quest. Upon completion, Korresia's Shop will open in Colony Mu.

Knife's Edge Pass (Japanese: , Hasaki no Keikokudō) is a Location in . It is located at the Great Sword's Base in the Cadensia Region. It can be reached by going to Morrack Inlet and following the trail south.
Lacquerwoods are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Aetia Region. They can also be produced from the Battlescar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Khaki Kernels are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced from the Desert Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Knowing Your Family (Japanese: , Kazoku wo Shiru Mono) is an Ascension Quest in , dedicated to Ghondor.
Kickitt Grebels are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Grebel family, and can be found at level 56-57 at the former site of Colony 0 in Nocclia Mire on Captocorn Peak.
Kugel Taos are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Taos family, and can be found at level 25-26 in Dannagh Desert.
Knightlord Tirkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 20-22 in Ribbi Flats and level 47 on the Urayan Trail.

The Lambda Ferronis (Japanese: ) is a Boss in . It is Colony Lambda's Ferronis, and is fought at level 28 alongside 2 Avis near the Aquifer Exhaust at the Great Cotte Falls. It is piloted by a mudpuppet version of Isurd created by Consul J.
Knockout Wasabis are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be purchased from the Ascension Caravan, or produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Kromar Fossils are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They are fossils of Kromars.

Lagoonites are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region, in particular at Malevolent Hollow and The Aegis Sea, southeast Erythia Sea. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Laia Fossils are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They are fossilized Laias.
Lantern Corals are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Killjoy Crustip Meats are items in . They are dropped by Crustips. One is needed during Happiness.
Kio Nos are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Droids, and can be found at level 62-63 at Amplifier No. 1, Amplifier No. 2, and the Amplifier Section in the Origin Interior.
Kio Zoonos are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Droids, and can be found at level 63-64 at Amplifier No. 1 and Amplifier No. 2 in the Origin Interior.
Kurono Horrishes are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Horrish family, and can be found at level 67-68 at the Hangar, Upper Level in the Origin Interior.

Kurria Flaks are nine Bosses in , labeled as the Center Defense Team. They are members of the Flak family, and are fought at level 68 in the Hangar Zone in the Origin Interior. They don't drop any items or gold.
Kroda Fliers are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Flier family, and can be found at level 56 at the Great Sword's Base and Erythia Sea, and level 48-49 at the Agnus Castle Barbican.
Kroda Wisps are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Wisp family, and can be found at level 40-41 at Great Sword's Base in the Cadensia Region.
Kinder Armus are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Armu family, and can be found at level 47-48 at the Agnus Castle Barbican.
The Lambda Commissary is a shop in . It is run by a Colony Lambda Soldier and can be found in Colony Lambda at Great Cotte Falls.
Kurt is an NPC in who can be found in Colony 9. He is a lifelong friend of Anita. __TOC__
Kyrie (Japanese: , Kirie) is an NPC in who can be found in Colony Gamma.
Kroda Skeeters are enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found at level 49-50 in Svinne Cavity in Yzana Plains.
The Lakeside Caravan is a shop in . It is a shop run by a Traderpon at the Llyn Nyddwr Camp in Ribbi Flats. It sells Ether Cylinders for 10000 G.
Korresia's Shop is a shop in . It is an Accessory shop run by Korresia in Colony Mu after completing Korresia Finds Her Calling.

Kikinu is a Nopon NPC in . Kikinu can be found first at Bennel Cave Camp during Chapter 2 and then at Lake Rezzento Camp in the Eagus Wilderness from Chapter 3 on. As part of the Nopon Register, they will give the party a Red Nopon Pebble.
Kokto Skwarors are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Skwaror family, and can be found at level 61-64 at Great Cotte Falls and in High Maktha Wildwood.
Landon Ropl are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ropl family, and can be found at level 10-11 in Alfeto Valley and on Melnath's Shoulder.
Knuckle Hoxes are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Hox family and can be found at level 13 in Reith Valley in the Eagus Wilderness.
Koror Vangs are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Vang family, and can be found at level 44-45 in Loska's Cavern on the Urayan Trail.
Last Ansels are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ansel family, and can be found at level 45-46 in Erythia Sea.
Korresia is an NPC in who can first be found in Colony Tau, then in Colony Mu after completing Korresia Finds Her Calling.
Knoquehardt's Levnis (Japanese: ) is a Quest Exclusive Boss. It is Knoquehardt's Levnis, a Sagittarius fought at level 66 in the Colony 11, Training Pit at Syra Hovering Reefs during Festival of War.
Knoquehardt is a NPC in . Knoquehardt can be found in Colony 11.
Larm Ansels are three Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Ansel family, and are fought at level 19 at Llyn Nyddwr at Ribbi Flats during Dorin and Bambam.

King's Bash is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Conqueror Deepwan while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Last Fencer (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Raucous Ron while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.
Lapidarist (Japanese: , Juerumaisutā, Jewel Meister) is a DLC Kevesi Healer class in .
Lapidarist Extraordinaire (Japanese: , Jueru Maisutā, lit. Jewel Meister) is a DLC Hero Quest in , dedicated to Masha. It is part of the New Hero & More Tough Challenges of the Expansion Pass.
The Lakeside Camp (Japanese: , Kohan no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in , located near Raguel Lake on The Ragmos Desolation.

The Lakeside Grotto (Japanese: , Kosui no Dōkutsu) is a Location in . It is located in Yesterdale, beneath Outlook Park. The Ravaged Village can be reached from here via an Ether Lift and two Ether Slides.
Larval Caterpiles are Normal Enemies in . They are members of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 21 in Yesterdale when Caterpile Pods hatch.
Kickin' Colony Acqua Pazza is a Meal item in . It can be cooked at Rest Spots. It is unlocked by obtaining the Colony Pazza Recipe.
Lance Ignas are two Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are members of the Igna family that are fought at level 52 in Zalmor's Thawtunnels on the Aurora Shelf during Takedown: Ignas.
Ladders are objects in . They are structures that the party can climb up and down. Like other climbable surfaces, getting on a ladder will immediately end any battle.
Kylie is a NPC in . She can be found near the Cathedral in the Residential District of New Los Angeles.
Lao's Custom Sniper Rifle is a ranged weapon in . It is a Sniper Rifle. It is Al's starting ranged weapon.

The L-002 Experimental Plant is an Important Item in . It is collected from the White Whale debris at Middle Hushflood in Noctilum during the course of My Dream if the party decides to "fight" (B route).
Kinnahan is an NPC in . She is an Ardainian who can be found by Old Valantia in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Kurolo is an NPC in . Kurolo is a Nopon who can be found in Torika Alley in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Kitson is a DLC NPC in . He is a Leftherian who can be found by Messet Point at Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago after Corvin is awakened. Speaking to him with Corvin in the party results in a conversation which unlocks Corvin's level 3 "Light Mastery". Kitson is not known to appear at any other time.

Lant is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who appears near Nharil Central Plaza in the Empire of Mor Ardain at the beginning of Failure and Success, where he, Tarsus, and Renaud try to force Ellenora to pay him. He is unable to be spoken to.

no6=LP is a track in , composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano. It is track six of disc one from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack, and the sixth part of the suite titled 0rCH-SUITE "X". This track plays at the end of the Affinity Mission Blitzkrieg if the party chooses to go to Bedrock Hold with Frye. In the , this track also plays during Al's story about his time in the Rift Between Worlds in Chapter 13 (Act 2).
The Leone Telethia (Japanese: , Reōne Tereshia) is a boss in . It is a Gigas-type Telethia, and is fought in the Decayed Forest in Makna Forest at level 36.

Lemonade Skies (Japanese: , Ramunesukai) are collectables in . They can be found in Makna Forest and Colony 6. They can also be obtained by trading with three NPCs in Frontier Village. According to their description, Sharla looked wistful as she named them and they are deep blue stones of nostalgia. Three are required for Colony 6 Reconstruction. In , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 12,200 Noponstones.

Light Rain Elements are rare materials in . They are only dropped by Aqua Nebulae on the Bionis' Leg during rain or thunderstorms. According to their description, they are water seeds that cause a rain shower that last ten seconds when thrown in the air. One is required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 1,300 Noponstones.

Leopold (Japanese: , Remōreon) is a Homs in . He can be found in the Commercial District of Colony 9. His girlfriend, Sylviane, is employed by King Squeeze to make him spend all of his money on her so King Squeeze can obtain his house and retire.
Liliana (Japanese: , Riruka) is a Homs in . She can be found playing outside Dunban's house in Colony 9 during the daytime.

Leku (Japanese: , Reku) is a Nopon in . He can be found in the northeastern section of the Archaeology Level in Frontier Village. At 12:00, he will move outside and can be found at the balcony. He is Kilaki's elder brother.

Lewisia Silvers (Japanese: , Rewishia Shirubā) are collectables in . They can be found in Agniratha and Colony 6. According to their description, they are wild white prairie flowers that retain their wildness after picking. Two are required for Colony 6 Reconstruction. In , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage at Time Attack for 12,900 Noponstones.

Lexos (Japanese: , Rekusosu) are enemies in the . They are rather uncommon serpentine aerial monsters and can be difficult to engage. They come in red and blue varieties. Lexos' appearance changes between games; in they have horns and fins as well as a more pronounced head. In , Lexos are more streamlined, with distinct scales, and have yellow wings.

Lecrough (Japanese: , Rokuro) is a pureblooded High Entia in Xenoblade Chronicles. He can be found at the bottom of the northern staircase in the Great Hall in Alcamoth, opposite to Galvin, from 06:00 to 18:00. He occupies the same post as Lar'shen. He is one of the Imperial Guards of Alcamoth who is often overrun with various missions.

Lighting Ronove (Japanese: , Inazuma no Ronowe) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon and can be found at level 55 near the Radio Tower in Sword Valley. It must be defeated for the Surprise Quest Secure the Radio Tower.
Light Heal (Japanese: , Raito Hīru) is one of Shulk's supporting arts in and . It replenishes a small amount of HP to himself or any active party member.
Light Shoes are light feet armour in . They can be obtained as a quest reward after completing The Key to a Long Life.
Light Bats (Japanese: , Raito Batto) are collectables in . They can be found in the Ether Mine. According to their description, they emit light from their bodies and nobody knows why they do this.

Leaf Mysteries (Japanese: , Rīfu Misuterī) are collectables in . They can be found in Tephra Cave. According to the description, Fiora named them with delight and it is a fresh leaf that quietly glows.
In and , Battle Arts can be levelled up by using AP and art books.

※ The Nopon Sage will immediately give another quest after this quest is cleared. See Challenge of the Sage. Legend of the Sage (Japanese: , Sennin no Densetsu) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from the Nopon Sage in Makna Forest, lying at the Ether Crystal Deposit area north of the Divine Sanctuary and southwest of Waypoint Beacon, from 12:00 to 15:00. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

※ After this quest is completed, Leku may offer another quest. See Hunt for a Patron. Leku's Food Crisis (Japanese: , Reku Ikka no Shokuryōkiki) is a quest in . It can be received from Leku in the upper area of the Archaeology Level in Frontier Village after registering Kilaki on the Affinity Chart. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.

Lemon Stones (Japanese: , Remon Seki) are collectables in . They can be found in Satorl Marsh. According to their description, breaking them will cause a golden liquid with a delicate lemon taste to come out. Five are required for Preventing Starvation.
Lightweight Drivers (Japanese: , Keiryōka Bankā) are weapons in . They are gunlances wielded by Reyn, and are only available via trade.

Light Armour (Japanese: , Keisōbi) tends towards low weight and an emphasis on Ether Defence. All characters can equip Light Armour. Light Armours have four general designs as represented by Glasses (head only), Swimming, Sky, and Makna, with several colour variants of each. The icon usually (but not always) reflects which of the three designs the armour has, with the Swimming and Sky designs sharing the same set of icons.
The Light Driver (Japanese: , Raitobankā) is a weapon in . It is a gunlance wielded by Reyn. It is not effective against Mechon. It can be dropped by various enemies in Colony 9.

Leaf Coils (Japanese: , Rīfu Koiru) are collectables in . They can be found in the Central Factory and Colony 6. According to their description, they are coils with a leafy colour and they are used as missiles in some fields.

Light Caps (Japanese: , Raito Kyappu) are light head armour in . They can be obtained by completing Education-Minded Suzanna or by trading with Suzanna herself. It becomes available for purchase at Colony 9's shop after the Mechon raid on the colony.
Leather Caps (Japanese: , Rezā Kyappu) are light head armour in . They are made from the skin of monsters found around Colony 9, although only dropped on the Bionis' Leg.

Legendary Nopon Charm (Japanese: , Nopon Dentō no Omajinai) is a quest in . It is received during Healing the Healer upon completing the second objective, and must be completed in order to satisfy that quest's third objective.

Lesunia (Japanese: , Ruīze) is a High Entia in Xenoblade Chronicles. She can be found southwest of the Imperial Palace in Alcamoth, wandering around near the connecting bridges. She initially refuses to speak to anyone who was not a pure-blooded High Entia but will talk to other races after completing Believing Again. After the events of Mechonis Core, Vidian reveals that she was transformed into a Telethia by Zanza and protected her when she fled Alcamoth alongside Arielle and asks the party to kill her during I Will Never Forget You or The Only Thing I Can Do.
Light Gloves are light arms armour in . They can be dropped by various enemies around Colony 9 and in Tephra Cave.
Light Bottoms are light legs armour in . They are popular in Colony 9.
Leather Gloves are light arms armour in . They can be dropped by Fine Fliers, and they are apparently made from their skin.
Light Tops are light torso armour in . They can be dropped by various enemies around Colony 9. They are said to be very popular in the colony.
Leather Tops are light torso armour in . They can be dropped by various enemies around Colony 9, or can be obtained as a quest reward after completing Missing in Action.

The Leg Pass (Japanese: , Ashi no Tōgemichi) is a landmark in . It is located on the third floor of Tephra Cave. It is reached by climbing some vines on a wall from Kneecap Hill. It leads up to the Ragrinar Canyon Path on Bionis' Leg. In , a Time Attack portal can be found here.
Legar Gear (Japanese: , Regādo Gia) is medium head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is commonly worn by elite troops of the Colony 6 Defence Force.
League Gear (Japanese: , Rīgu Gia) is medium head armour in . It can be dropped by Shadow Vangs.
League Armour is medium torso armour in . It can be dropped by many Armus, and be obtained as a quest reward after completing Reversed Tastes. It is commonly worn by traveling High Entia.
Lattice Armour is medium torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
League Gauntlets are medium arms armour in . They are commonly worn by travelling High Entia.
Lattice Gauntlets are medium arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
League Leggings are medium legs armour in . They are favoured by travelling High Entia. They can be obtained as a quest reward after completing Giant Attack!.
Lattice Leggings are medium legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Legar Leggings are medium legs armour in . They were commonly worn by the elite troops of the Colony 6 Defence Force.
Lattice Boots are medium feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Leg Volffs are enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found along Gaur Plain at night or in the Volff Lair anytime on Bionis' Leg. They are usually found in packs, along with a Leader Volff. Three of them must be defeated to complete Bionis' Leg's Monster Quest 1 - Part 4.

Leg Arduns are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Ardun family, and can be found along Gaur Plain on Bionis' Leg. They are usually found in a group with Daughter Armus and Leg Armus. Two of them must be defeated to complete Bionis' Leg's Monster Quest 1 - Part 1.
Legar Boots are medium feet armour in . They were worn by elite troops of the Colony 6 Defence Force.
League Boots are medium feet armour in . They are favoured by travelling High Entia. They can be dropped by various enemies.

Leg Piranhax (Japanese: , Reggu Samon) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Piranhax family, and can be found at level 13 in several ponds of Gaur Plain in Bionis' Leg, in particular the ones located northeast and southwest of Jabos Rock Rest Area. They can drop Piranhax Roe, which is required for Out-of-Luck Giorgio.
Light Wisps are enemies in . They are members of the Wisp family, and can be found at level 13 in Gaur Plain on Bionis' Leg. They can drop the Glowing Wisp Fluid needed for Emergency Treatment.

Lightspeed Sonid (Japanese: , Kōsoku no Sonīdo) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Eks family, and can be found at level 44 at Anu Shore at the Eryth Sea, and must be defeated to complete the quest Challenge 4 from Alcamoth. It drops Silver Eks Plates, two of which are needed for the quest Starlight Seeker.

Lelepago Pterix are enemies in . They are members of the Pterix family, and can be found at level 55, circling around the east side of the Digit 2 Plain and occasionally to the northeast of the Giant Mechon Debris on the Fallen Arm. Defeating two of them is required to complete the quest A Tough Battle given by Kazat in Hidden Machina Village. They drop Pterix Energy Eggs, two of which may be used as one method of completing Lifespan of a Machina.
Ledios Helms (Japanese: , Rediosu Herumu) are heavy head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be bought at Colony 6, when the commerce of the colony has been upgraded to level five.
Ledios Plates are heavy torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by the Demon King Dragonia and the Invited Slobos.
Ledios Arms are heavy arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They have the highest defense of any arms armour with an empty gem slot. They can be dropped by the Demon King Dragonia.
Ledios Cuisses are heavy legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various enemies.
Ledios Greaves are heavy feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from a shop which opens after Commerce reaches level five during Colony 6 Reconstruction.
The Lieutenant Pike (Japanese: , Rutenanpaiku) is a weapon in . It is a gunlance wielded by Reyn.

This quest will expire if Medical Advancements is completed first. Let's Make Fillings! (Japanese: , Ireba wo Tsukuru) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Yusa in the Underground Store in Frontier Village. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment. This quest and Medical Advancements are mutually exclusive. After this quest is completed, Npa may offer Healing the Healer and Kofuko may offer Reversed Tastes.
Lightning (Japanese: , Raitoningu) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are rifles that can be wielded by Sharla.

Lazy Bluco (Japanese: , Taida no Burūko) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Eluca family, and can be found at level 34 during the night in the Yellow Flower Grove in eastern Makna Forest. The Lazy Bluco must be defeated to complete the Frontier Village's Challenge 3. Additionally, it can drop Green Eluca Juice, which is needed for A Worried Bug-Lover.

Leg Skeeters are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found on the Bionis' Leg, north of Gaur Plain. They are the only enemy that drops Thick Nectar, which is needed for Weak Berryjammy.

Lightning Attack (Japanese: , Kaminari Tsuigeki) is a Gem in that adds electric damage to auto-attacks. This gem should not be confused with Electric Plus, a Gem type that increases the damage of electric attacks. __TOC__

Leg Tokilos are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Tokilos family. They can be found at level 79 on the ledge just east of Zax Guidepost on Bionis' Leg, but only when it is not raining. They drop the Tokilos King Egg required for the Replica Monado 5 quest and to Reconstruct Colony 6's Nature to level 5. They also guard the Tokilos' Egg needed for With Much Gratitude.

Leg Arachno (Japanese: , Reggu Supaido) are enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family. Leg Arachno can be found at level 16-18 in Kisk Cave on Bionis' Leg, east of the Refugee Camp and south of Viliera Hill. They are the only enemies to drop Sticky Web Fibres, which are needed for Being a Good Grandfather.

Lifespan of a Machina (Japanese: , Rōjin Mashīna no Jumyō) is a quest in . It can be received from Neonik in Colony 6 after the events at Mechonis Core and after she has migrated to the colony; she will be found upstairs near the lake during the day. The party must obtain either two Pterix Energy Eggs from Lelepago Pterix on the Fallen Arm, or a Machina Energy at the Mechon Wreckage Site in Colony 9. The Machina Energy will extend her life for a period of 20 years, while the Pterix Energy Eggs will extend her life for a considerably longer period, causing her to outlive the other residents of the colony.

Lift Battle (Japanese: , Rifuto Saikidō Sakusen) is a Story Quest in . It is received at the Main Maintenance Bay in Galahad Fortress. The Mechon is the Sentinel Mechon in the 2nd Fuel Supply Room, it will drop the Fortress Pass Key needed for complete this quest.

Lexos Beards are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Racti Lexos in Eryth Sea and traded for in Alcamoth and Eryth Sea. According to their description, they are beards that shine in all the colours of the rainbow that make for great decoration. Two of them are needed for the quest Material Quest 4 (Alcamoth).

Legend of Mythical Empress (Japanese: , Shin: Densetsu no Enpuresu) is a quest in . It can be received by Gerugu in the Traveller's Rest on Bionis' Leg. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment. The quest is available after completing With Even More Gratitude and It Definitely Exist!, and once the Colony 6 area affinity reached ☆3.5. The "green" relationship prerequisite between Pachipa and Pipiki is obtained once the Frontier Village's quest It Definitely Exist! has been completed then Pachipa is spoken to.

Leg Armus are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Armu family, and can be found at level 13 in Gaur Plain on Bionis' Leg. They are usually found in a group with Leg Arduns and Daughter Armus. They can drop the Thick Armu Milk needed for Cook-Off Counter Attack!.

Laughing Brog Bags are rare materials in . They can be dropped by Brogs in Colony 9, or traded for with Perrine if she has not moved to Colony 6 or if Mefimefi has moved over her. According to their description, they are bags full of Brog laughter that make a croaking sound. Two are needed for Désirée's Apology.

Licorne Telethia (Japanese: , Rikorunu Tereshia) are enemies in . They are Licorne-type members of the Telethia family, and can be found at level 73 in the Second Lung of Bionis' Interior. They can drop a slotted version of the Rex Cuisses.
Leg Antols (Japanese: , Reggu Antoru) are enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found at level 13 on Bionis' Leg in the Windy Cave and near the Daksha Shrine.
Leader Volff (Japanese: , Rīdā Vorufu) is an enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 17 from the Gaur Plain to Raguel Lake on Bionis' Leg.
Leg Lizards (Japanese: , Reggu Rizado) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Lizard family, and can be found at levels 16-18 southeast of Spiral Valley on Bionis' Leg.

The Lazy Hox (Japanese: , Taida no Hoggusu) is a quest exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Hox family, and can be found at level 34 at the end of the Splintered Path in Colony 6 during A Selfish Girl's Mistake. It is not required to defeat it for the quest.

Lexos God Elixirs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are dropped by the Clamorous Dablon, a Unique Monster found in Sleeping Dragon Isle during stormy weather. It cannot be obtained in any other way.
The Legislative District is a location in . It is located on the third floor of Agniratha, opposite the Judicial District. The Soothed Aglovale, a Unique Monster, can be found here.
The Left Leg Cooling Outlet (Japanese: , Kishin Hidariashi: Reikyakuguchi) is a landmark in . It is located on the left leg of Mechonis, and is the entrance to Mechonis Field from the Fallen Arm.
Life's Hard for a Heropon (Japanese: , Yūsha wa Tsurai mo) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at Riki's House in Frontier Village, between Dunban and Riki at pink affinity.
The Letter for Emmy is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Delivering it to Emmy Leater is the objective of A Young Captain's Trust.
Lepyxes (Japanese: , Fontera) are large, four-legged creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
The Leader's Plate is a rare material in Xenoblade Chronicles. For unknown reasons, it was cut from the game. It was most likely intended to be dropped by Yaldabaoth.

The Lifehold Core is the story-exclusive final region in . It is the location of the final battles in the plot, and can only be entered during Chapter 12. After this, the Lifehold Core is still present in the waters of Cauldros, but it can no longer be entered. It is known as Central Life in the Japanese version. Although the Core's interior is a sheltered location, after entering the HUD shows the weather to be thunderstorms, regardless of what the weather was outside. The weather changes to clear for the second phase of the final boss battle.

The Leaning Ring (Japanese: , Taore An'noun Ringu, Toppling Unknown Ring) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a large ring structure located in Oblivia: east of the Yawning Giant, southeast of Aaroy Plain, and southwest of Barbarich Desert. It must be visited during A Friend in Need and approaching it after completing Adventure! will trigger Mighty Mia.

Lawless Grexes (Japanese: , Rafian Rupusu, Ruffian Lupus) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Grexes and can be found at level 31-40 at Beasts' Lair, Talon Rock Second Terrane, and guarding the bridges to Fallshorn Isle in Primordia. They drop the White Mirrorglasses needed for Setting Forth.
Lava Ciniculas (Japanese: , Rāva Vasaruto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cinicula family, and can be found at level 49 northeast of M'gando Gorge BC in Cauldros.

Lava Caro (Japanese: , Rabaru Nokkusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caro family, and can be found at level 31-32 or at level 35-40 near the Titan's Table in Cauldros.
Lightning Progen (Japanese: , Raitoningu Ekuusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Progen and can be found at level 31-33 at Middle Hushflood, in Noctilum.

Legion Caro (Japanese: , Region Nokkusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caro family and can be found at level 40 in Cauldros, northwest of FN Site 511 anytime except late night.

Lethal Duoguills (Japanese: , Kirā Guira) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Duoguill family and can be found at level 48-50 at the South Coast and the Floating Reef in Oblivia.

The Lesser Gemini Bridge (Japanese: , Daini no Sōji-bashi) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a natural bridge located in Primordia, and must be crossed to reach the Bedrock Hold. It is patrolled by a single Puge.

Lepidolite Scirpos (Japanese: , Repido Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family, and can be found at level 6-7 west of FN Site 116 and at level 10 on the sea-facing side of a rock with a large tree atop it east of FN Site 116 in Primordia. They may be difficult to find due to their small size.
Lightning Cloak is one of many Support Arts in . It grants Electric Res Up to the user and allies.
Libra, the Long-Lived (Japanese: , Chōmei no Ribura) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Purgovent family. It can be found at level 20 at North Coast in Oblivia.
Liceors (Japanese: , Kurāra) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are large bird-like creatures with horn-shaped heads similar to Saltats. They are exclusive to Sylvalum.

Lesser Anvil (Japanese: , Anbiru Ganban) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, northwest of Badr Stonebridge. The anvil-shaped stone structure contains Ganglion encampments on the north side and on top.

Lawless Mephites (Japanese: , Rafian Mepitesu. Ruffian Mephite) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mephite family, and can be found at level 34-37 in Cauldros. A group of four or five can be found directly north of Drongo Caravan.
Lava Mangos (Japanese: , Rabamangō) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum. Two are required for A Tip of the Cap.
Lava Chestnuts (Japanese: , Yōganmaron) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros.
